entry_state: The commitment lapse and funded alternatives preserve distinct exposures. The ordinary loan separates accrual, credit deterioration, collection and write-off; POCI instead embeds initial losses in its credit-adjusted rate and recognises subsequent signed changes. Dated receipts and partial write-offs preserve financial and legal claim histories separately. Fractional periods and an irrational original rate require propagated enclosures; the rate-bracket example continues with its dated financial path.
exit_state: The rate enclosure follows one shared original rate through the whole loan. Modified terms, recovered credit and reversal of SICR remain separate findings. Collateral cash after maturity stays in loss measurement and accounting write-off does not waive legal rights. Revolving capacity, integral and service fees, eligible partial sales and continuing guarantees have now been distinguished; option-based transfer exposures follow next.
findings: The rate-bracket result prohibits combining independent interval endpoints as jointly attainable journals.
The cure comparison preserves different interest and impairment amounts even when closing wealth agrees.
Delayed collateral receipts are discounted at their actual dates and enforcement proceeds are counted only once.
Transfer examples distinguish eligible cash-flow parts, relative fair-value allocation, secured borrowing and continuing involvement. No new confirmed defect.
